name: TC-AN-QB-001 — 复制按钮：有已选参与人时成功复制 [P0]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开，已选参与人区域有至少1位参与人
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false, error: '无可编辑节点' }; })()
steps.description: 点击第一个节点的编辑按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const label = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).find(el => (el.textContent || '').trim().startsWith('已选参与人')); if (!label) return { found: false, error: '未找到已选参与人标签' }; const parent = label.closest('[class*=participantSection]') || label.closest('.ant-form-item') || label.parentElement; const btns = parent ? Array.from(parent.querySelectorAll('button')) : []; const copyBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('复制')); return { found: !!copyBtn, btnText: copyBtn ? copyBtn.textContent.trim() : '', parentText: parent ? parent.textContent.substring(0, 200) : '' }; })()
steps.description: 探查已选参与人区域及复制按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const copyBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('复制')); if (!copyBtn) return { clicked: false, error: '未找到复制按钮' }; copyBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const toasts = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice, .ant-notification-notice'); const toastTexts = Array.from(toasts).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const hasSuccessToast = toastTexts.some(t => t.includes('已复制') && t.includes('位参与人')); return { toasts: toastTexts, hasSuccessToast }; })()
steps.description: 验证toast提示'已复制 N 位参与人'

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开，已选参与人区域有至少1位参与人
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 进入审核节点编辑页\n2. 确认已选参与人区域有人员\n3. 点击「复制」按钮
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 已选参与人数据被复制到剪贴板，格式为[{empId,empName}]的JSON数组\n2. 页面toast提示「已复制 N 位参与人」
_testDesign.groupPath: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮
